text:
Predicates:
RosesGivenOut(x) ::: x is a TV show on which roses are given out.
Time(x, y) ::: x is on at time y.
OnBachelor(x) ::: x is on the Bachelor.
PortraysRealPeople(x) ::: x portrays the lives of real people.
RealityTV(x) ::: x is a reality TV show.
BreakingBad(x) ::: x is Breaking Bad.
Mondays(y) ::: y is on a Monday.
Premises:
∃x (RosesGivenOut(x) ∧ Time(x, monday8pm)) ::: On some Mondays at 8 pm, roses are given out on TV.
∀x (RosesGivenOut(x) → OnBachelor(x)) ::: Every rose given out on TV is on the Bachelor.
∀x (OnBachelor(x) → PortraysRealPeople(x)) ::: Everything on the Bachelor portrays the lives of real people.
∀x (PortraysRealPeople(x) → RealityTV(x)) ::: All shows portraying the lives of real people are reality TV shows.
¬RealityTV(breakingBad) ::: Breaking Bad is not a reality TV show.
Conclusion:
∃x (Mondays(y) ∧ Time(breakingBad, x) ∧ RosesGivenOut(breakingBad)) ::: Breaking Bad is a TV show in which roses are given out on Monday at 8 pm.
